title: ordering.order-cancelled v1
description: An order was cancelled before it was shipped. wasPaid tells whether money has to be returned. The free-text note the customer may have typed is deliberately not part of the event. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know: adding one is a backward-compatible change.

eventId.description: Unique per occurrence; the message-id consumers deduplicate on.

aggregateVersion.description: Version of the aggregate after the change; detects gaps and reordering.

customerId.description: The account that owns the order.

wasPaid.description: Whether the order had been paid when it was cancelled.
